test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On: 2 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Raghuvir purchased some perishable items for sale but 36% of those items could not be sold and went bad. However, Raghuvir managed to sell the rest of the items at a price that helped him earn an overall profit of 28%. At what percentage above the cost price of each item did Raghuvir sell each of the items that did not go bad?
solution:
Given:

36% of items went bad and total profit must be 28 %.

Concept used:

Profit = SP - CP

Profit% = (SP - CP)/CP× 100

S.P. = ( C.P. × 100) × (100 + Profit %),

where S.P. → Selling Price , C.P. → Cost Price

Calculation:

Let the cost of one item is 1 Rs.

Therefore, cost of 100 items will be 100 Rs.

As 36% went bad, so remaining items are 100 - 36 = 64.

Note that total over all profit must be 28 %.

⇒ S.P. = ( C.P. × 100) × (100 + Profit %),

⇒ S.P. = ( 100 × 100) × (100 + 28 %),

⇒ 128 Rs.

Now 64 must items must be sold in 128

Profit = SP - CP

⇒ 128 - 64

⇒ 64

Profit% = (SP - CP)/CP× 100

⇒ 64/64 × 100

⇒ 100%

∴ The correct option is 1.
